title: Sprint 15 planning: genesis consistency + optional DB snapshots
brief: Спланировать отдельный архитектурный спринт: согласованность кросс-шард балансов/генезиса, модель foreign balance visibility, preflight readiness, и опциональное хранение snapshot в БД вместо JSON.
tracks: A: cross-shard balance semantics and readiness protocol
notes: Keep protocol safety first: no hidden foreign-balance assumptions; prefer explicit authoritative source semantics and deterministic recovery paths. Backlog triage 2026-05-16: genesis consistency/snapshot abstraction were carried into V2-9/V3; optional DB snapshot backend should be a fresh future task if needed.
